name: dynamics-connection-compatibility
title: Design the no-SDK Dynamics 365 access gateway
description: Design a shared, no-SDK Dynamics 365 8.2/9.1 Organization access gateway for five current products and future products, including profile-isolated connection-pool ownership, Web API compatibility, and a complete SDK-removal migration boundary.
creator: codex
notes: 2026-07-31 Phase 4 local control-plane follow-up completed: SQL Server 2025 LocalDB dynamic-EXEC parser compatibility was repaired in both runtime and checked-in schema; explicit opt-in -RemoveDrainedUnboundEpochs recovery removed only 6 proven-drained stale slots and 1 epoch. Default provisioning remains non-destructive. Fresh fixed-LocalDB provisioning and Dynamics Release validation passed 306/306 (including the opt-in live contract), and post-test contract-prefix slot/epoch/binding rows were 0. Release solution build passed with 0 warnings/errors. Package01FeeReadsEnabled remains false. The sole immediate external gate is CRMWeb CE 9.1 Claims/IFD HTTP 500/UriFormatException: only an approved CRM deployment-admin persistence check and, if an actual setting changed, one connector-owned WhoAmI smoke may advance it. Real CE 8.2/9.1 operation matrix, cross-process capacity/fault, soak/performance, Phase 5, and Phase 6 remain open.
